title: Released family candidate composition and actual CPU source binding
question: Can released five-family candidate roles preserve source locations, structural paths and unresolved states through shared assembly?
method: Independent focused source fixtures for all five released families; actual retained source CPU definition operation; root integrated-tree rerun of80 focused tests.
conclusion: 80 focused tests passed on integrated main tree2026-11-03. Actual CPU produced three located private candidates and joined; definition associations were incorrect/unqualified, so this establishes source binding and shape only. Attempt1 retained failed before inference. Other-family actual-source routing, native persistence, accepted publication and release quality remain open.
